skipInShell: it uses Buffer, process and Bun, which the jsc shell does not have
skipInVariants: its output is what a program refuses that the flow analysis found closed, and a variant without the results of the analysis refuses nothing

skipInVariant.trimmed-runtime: the text it evaluates calls process.openStdin, which the source never calls: --trim removes it, and the call throws

alone: what it prints hangs on what else the executable holds: which modules and members were compiled in, and whether anything evaluates text
